parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the GA instance to be queried.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga get-ipsets-bandwidth-limit --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
